snippet.title: SALMON MAN - GAME UPDATE - The UploadVR Showcase - Summer 2026
snippet.description: 🐟 Salmon Man goes MULTIPLAYER!  Salmon Man is a physics-based VR platformer where you climb upstream using nothing but your paddle. This July, compete with friends as you fight your way to the top.  Unlock new paddles and achievements, conquer the all-new extreme Lava Mode, and explore a brand-new mountain map. Grab a friend, start climbing, and see who reaches the top first!
